about.title: 🧠 About
about.body: I am a solution-focused Software Architect with over 20 years designing, building, and scaling high-impact applications. I operate at the intersection of architecture, engineering, and leadership to deliver real business outcomes.

roles.title: Technical Lead
roles.summary: Led an Agile payments team, architected React + .NET payment flows, and coached developers through reviews, planning, and retros.
achievements: Built new payment methods & processes for global rollout.
roles.tech: .NET, WebAPI, React, AWS, SQL Server, MySQL, PowerShell, Bash, Microservices

roles.title: Team Lead
roles.summary: Managed and motivated a Trading Division team; modernized CI/CD and engineering practices.
roles.tech: .NET Core, ASP.NET, Azure, YAML, SQL Server, Microservices, PowerShell

roles.title: Principal Engineer
roles.summary: Grew team from 0 → 5, delivered MVPs that unlocked new revenue streams.
achievements: Established AWS-based CI/CD with Docker + Octopus Deploy.
Built cross-platform cloud apps with Angular + .NET Core.
roles.tech: .NET, Angular, AWS, Azure, TypeScript, NodeJS, MySQL, Serverless

roles.title: Senior Architect
roles.summary: Directed cloud-first internal apps (AWS EC2/RDS/S3), mentored teams in ASP.NET & Angular.
roles.tech: .NET, Angular, AWS, Azure, TypeScript, SQL Server, MySQL, PowerShell

roles.title: Technical Architect
roles.summary: Led flagship product development and mentored engineers.
achievements: Built automated CI/CD with GitHub + Jenkins + TeamCity.
roles.tech: .NET, Angular, AWS, SQL Server, Bootstrap, Dapper

roles.title: Software Architect
roles.summary: Created the company’s Markdown product and mission-critical apps; prototyped on SQL Server & VoltDB.

roles.title: Director of Software Engineering
roles.summary: Directed product architecture, development, and delivery.
roles.tech: .NET, MVC, WebAPI, SQL Server, NUnit, WCF

quote: “Great software isn’t just code — it’s collaboration, clarity, and craftsmanship.”
